caption: The drawing depicts two brown, oval-shaped objects with handles, positioned parallel to each other, both oriented horizontally within a rectangular border. Each object has a rounded bowl, reminiscent of a spoon, and they both appear to be made of wood or a dark-toned material, as indicated by the texture and shading. The upper object is shown with the bowl facing down, while the lower object has the bowl facing up, revealing a smooth, concave surface. Both have short, slightly tapered handles and a central hinge or connection point, suggesting they might once be joined or able to pivot. There are subtle highlights and shadows indicating a light source from the upper right, and each object casts a soft, grayish shadow onto a pale background. The lines and shading throughout the composition are clear and precise, emphasizing the contours and giving a three-dimensional appearance to the objects. The overall palette consists mainly of brown, beige, and muted gray tones.
title: Tablespoon Mold
